summary: Iteration 10 verification (docs + frontend UX polish). All acceptance criteria PASS: SetupGuide substrings present + old strings removed, README==SETUP.md byte-for-byte, /api/status 200 with admin token, Leaflet LayersControl on both dashboard & situational view with all 5 layers (Dark/Streets/Satellite/Terrain/Street labels) and Satellite loads Esri tiles, RadioDetailModal shows all 5 tabs with correct panels & testids, direct message send fires POST /api/messages and shows 'Message queued' toast, mobile tab renamed to 'RADIOS'.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX: After sending a direct message from the modal (detail-tab-msg), the modal appears to close because onSaved refreshes the parent list and unmounts. Consider not calling onSaved on message send, or preserving the open modal state so user can see the newly-appended message in detail-msg-history without reopening.

WebSocket connections warn on close during navigation (expected, not a bug), but the situational view WS 'closed before connection established' warning could be quieted by tracking mount state in the WS effect.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter-10 acceptance criteria confirmed via Playwright against public URL. Setup guide substrings verified both via file diff (README.md == frontend/public/SETUP.md) and in-app rendering. Map basemaps controlled by /app/frontend/src/components/BaseLayers.jsx are correctly wired into MapView and SituationalView. RadioDetailModal enhanced 5-tab UI works E2E; only observation is that onSaved after sendDirectMessage may cause the modal to close since parent refreshes state — considered a minor UX polish, not a bug.
